title: Affine spectrum transport of a localized structure-image model
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be any morphism of schemes and $M$ an $\mathcal O_X$-module [def-pc-module-pullback]. Let $k:W\to S$, let $U$ be an affine open of $W$, and put $R=\Gamma(W,U)$. Supply derived categories on all schemes and localized open sites [def-pc-derived-category]. Assume the tensor pullback of $M$ to $X\times_S U$ is isomorphic to its structure module. Let $P$ be any cochain complex of $R$-modules whose termwise affinePerfectSheafification [lem-pc-affine-perfect-module-model] represents on the localized $U$ site the restriction of $R(p_W)_*(q_W^*M[0])$, for the projections $p_W:X\times_S W\to W$ and $q_W:X\times_S W\to X$ [def-pc-derived-direct-image]. Put $j:\operatorname{Spec}(R)\to S$ equal to the affine spectrum isomorphism inverse followed by $U\hookrightarrow W$ and $k$. Then $Q(\widetilde P)$ is isomorphic to $R(p_j)_*\mathcal O_{X\times_S\operatorname{Spec}(R)}[0]$. No flatness, quasi-compactness, separatedness, or K-flatness is assumed.

source.place: Tag 08FE (Lemma 20.32.4); Tag 06Z0 and exact transport along the affine spectrum isomorphism; Tags 0095 and 0096 for tensor-pullback composition

proof.text: Set j0 = isoSpec.inv followed by the open inclusion. The pullback universal property gives a cartesian open-immersion square from X times_S Spec R to X times_S W. Derive the sectionwise pushforward_restrict_square comparison from DirectImage.Sections (the open-square comparison used by lem-pc-sections-open-base-change). Exact restriction preserves K-injective complexes, so the right-derived composition comparisons identify restriction of the direct image with the direct image of the restricted single coefficient. The single-functor comparison and uniqueness of the tensor-pullback adjoint identify that coefficient with the ordinary tensor pullback.

The canonical projection from X times_S Spec R to X times_S U, together with tensorPullbackCompositionIso, pulls the supplied trivialization to Spec R. The tensor-unit isomorphism gives the structure module there. A second tensor composition comparison identifies it with the coefficient in the open-square comparison.

Apply the exact derived functor of overEquiv.functor followed by restriction along isoSpec.inv to hrep. The exact-functor composition and localization factorization comparisons identify the left side with restriction along j0. On the right, cancel overEquiv.inverse followed by overEquiv.functor using its counit, then cancel restriction along isoSpec.hom followed by isoSpec.inv using restriction composition and identity. The mapHomologicalComplexCompIso gives Q(tilde P). Compose the inverse representation comparison with the open-square comparison and the image of the coefficient trivialization.

proof_origin.place: Tags 08FE, 06Z0, 0096, 0A1D and 08DW(2); exact restriction, affine chart cancellation and canonical base change

theorem picard_affine_structure_model_transport
    [∀ Y : Scheme.{v},
      HasDerivedCategory.{v + 1} (SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ (Y : Scheme.{v}) (U : Y.Opens), HasDerivedCategory.{v + 1}
      (SheafOfModules.{v} ((moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace).over U))]
    {X S : Scheme.{v}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    (M : X.Modules) (W : Scheme.{v}) (k : W ⟶ S)
    (U : W.Opens) (hU : IsAffineOpen U)
    (htrivial : Nonempty
      ((Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f (U.ι ≫ k))).obj M ≅
        SheafOfModules.unit (pullback f (U.ι ≫ k)).ringCatSheaf))
    (P : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{v} (W.presheaf.obj (.op U))) ℤ)
    (hrep : Nonempty ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{v}
        (moduleRings W.toRingedSpace) U).mapDerivedCategory.obj
        ((schemeDerivedDirectImage (pullback.snd f k)).obj
          ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
            (SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings (pullback f k).toRingedSpace)) 0).obj
            ((Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f k)).obj M))) ≅
        DerivedCategory.Q.obj
          (((affinePerfectSheafification W U hU).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P))) :
    let j : Spec (W.presheaf.obj (.op U)) ⟶ S := hU.isoSpec.inv ≫ U.ι ≫ k
    Nonempty
      (DerivedCategory.Q.obj
        ((@Functor.mapHomologicalComplex _ _ _ _ _ _ _
          (@id (ModuleCat.{v} (W.presheaf.obj (.op U)) ⥤
            SheafOfModules.{v}
              (moduleRings (Spec (W.presheaf.obj (.op U))).toRingedSpace))
            (tilde.functor (W.presheaf.obj (.op U))))
          ⟨fun _ _ ↦ tilde.map_zero⟩ (.up ℤ)).obj P) ≅
        (schemeDerivedDirectImage (pullback.snd f j)).obj
          ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
            (SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings (pullback f j).toRingedSpace)) 0).obj
              (SheafOfModules.unit (pullback f j).ringCatSheaf)))
